Earth observation constellation demonstration and 3D printed structure.
Description

Perform detailed studies of changes in the magnetic field and the Earth gravity. Imaging the Earth in 4m resolution (obtained through the use of an innovative lens. If succeed, it would become the first Polish-made commercial and private satellite. The entire structure was made in 3D printing technology,
